checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with a large, visibly tired-looking human face
must.why: 640x360 16:9; left face is large, tired and lit by blue light.

must.item: Headline high-contrast and readable at phone size
must.why: Big white bold text on dark background.

must.item: Face and headline unobstructed, not awkwardly cropped
must.why: Headline fully inside the frame; faces visible, the left face is slightly close to the left edge but not cropped.

faults.what: Headline is two words, not three as the must-have requires (though it matches the user's request).
Right person looks different from left person (different hair and face), so not clearly the same person.
Phone on the right is face-up, not clearly face-down as asked (screen appears lit).

summary: A clean, legible split-screen thumbnail with correct "STOP SCROLLING" text, red X and green check, but the headline is two words rather than three, the person is not clearly the same on both sides, and it is only 640px wide.
